design_principle: sample from inference downward: direct trait reconnaissance first, focal population RAD second, transition-neighbourhood expansion third, M01 expansion only after mechanism promotion, optional all-Japan RAD sensitivity last

species_scaffold.primary: Moreyra et al. 2025 target-capture nuclear framework
species_scaffold.rad_role: population ancestry, admixture/reticulation and transition-history localization below the species scaffold
species_scaffold.prohibited: RAD is not the unconditional definitive Japan-wide species tree

S0_trait_reconnaissance.narrow_endemic_rule: one verified population x >=5 flowering individuals when only one population is accessible
S0_trait_reconnaissance.optional_silica_bank: up to 3 outcome-blind individuals/concept when authorized; bank only, no automatic sequencing
S0_trait_reconnaissance.output: frozen individual/population trait table before S2 nomination

systems.purpose: P01 phyllary-history localization plus polymorphism-aware ancestry

S1_rad_pilot_nested.polyploid_boundary: this pilot does not qualify high-ploidy/polyploid S2/S4 strata; run a separate stratum check before their production sequencing

nomination_algorithm: reconstruct admissible transition-edge set for orientation, phyllary and stickiness on fixed public topology ensemble
include all directly observed polymorphic concepts
for each trait add the smallest concept neighbourhood set covering >=80% cumulative transition-placement uncertainty
take union across traits before sequencing

opens_only_if: E2 expression association replicates across two discovery populations within each focal lineage
S3_m01_expansion.selection_boundary: RAD supplies population/background structure; candidate-region selection evidence requires a non-RAD confirmation assay

opens_only_if: dissertation still requires all-Japan RAD sensitivity after S1/S2
single-protocol or explicitly compatible stratum shared-locus gate passes
S4_optional_all_japan_rad.sampling: use S0 bank; up to 3 wild individuals/concept split across >=2 populations where feasible
S4_optional_all_japan_rad.stop_rule: cancel if restriction-site dropout or mixed ploidy prevents a defensible common matrix

individual_sampling.within_population_spacing: >=10 m where feasible; avoid obvious connected/clonal ramets
individual_sampling.sampling_geometry: spread across occupied patch rather than edge cluster
individual_sampling.dna_tissue: silica-dried leaf from all admitted RAD individuals
individual_sampling.voucher_rule: voucher where legal plus diagnostic images for every individual

cytotype_sampling.default_focal_population: target direct flow/genome-size confirmation on 3 individuals/population when fresh logistics permit
cytotype_sampling.suspected_mixed_cytotype: increase direct cytotype sampling and do not pool unresolved individuals in dosage-dependent analysis
cytotype_sampling.polyploid_s2_s4: cytotype qualification required before dosage-dependent pooled inference

investigator_priority: JPN06/JPN15 sites requiring careful identification/conservation handling
